* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet (official text as of 15 March 2010), slip 3•21: “Deploys -1 to same site as your MTT. AT-AT Cannon may deploy aboard, and targets it hits may not be used to satisfy attrition. Unless alone, draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 15 March 2010"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022213441/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the original text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a version (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Virtual Block 6.3 sheet came out on 12 March 2010, three days before the date it carries<ref name="pc-6_3-release">Players Committee home page, news “Virtual Block 6.3: Mercenaries – Released!”, posted 4:40pm Friday, 12 March 2010, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20100409002355/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ 9 April 2010] (Internet Archive); the Players Committee Twitter account wrote on 13 March 2010 that the set “has been released early!” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20100721144451/http://twitter.com/swccg Internet Archive copy])</ref>.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Droid Walker (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “may not be used” to “cannot be used”: “Deploys -1 to same site as your MTT. AT-AT Cannon may deploy aboard, and targets it hits cannot be used to satisfy attrition. Unless alone, draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.”<ref name="cl-1263_21-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
